name: Ravelry Pattern Search
description: The most comprehensive database of knitting and crochet patterns anywhere. Free and paid patterns, filterable by craft, difficulty, yarn weight, and more.

name: Yarnspirations Free Patterns
description: Over 11,000 free knitting and crochet patterns from Bernat, Caron, Lily, and Patons. Quality tested by professional designers.

name: LoveCrafts Free Patterns
description: Thousands of free knitting and crochet patterns. Good filtering by project type, skill level, and yarn weight.

name: TL Yarn Crafts (YouTube)
description: Toni Lipsey's channel with clear, well-paced crochet tutorials. Great for visual learners and beginners.

name: Very Pink Knits (YouTube)
description: Staci Perry's channel with detailed knitting tutorials. Excellent close-up shots and calm, clear teaching style.

name: Bella Coco Crochet (YouTube)
description: Sarah-Jayne's beginner-friendly crochet tutorials. Very popular in the UK. Covers basics through advanced techniques.

name: Wool and the Gang
description: Modern knitting and crochet kits with everything you need included. Great for beginners who want a complete project in a box.

name: LoveKnitting / LoveCrafts
description: Wide selection of yarn, needles, hooks, and accessories. Good prices and they deliver to most countries.

name: Knitting Help
description: Free instructional knitting videos covering every technique from casting on to complex stitch patterns. A classic learning resource.

name: All About Ami
description: Beautiful blog focused on amigurumi (crocheted stuffed animals) with free patterns and detailed photo tutorials.
